clips.title: The story
paras: Turak Runetotem gives Cenarion Lunardust to young tauren druids on Thunder Bluff. They use it to awaken Lunaclaw at an ancient Moonkin Stone between Mulgore and the Barrens.

Cenarion Lunardust carries the Cenarion Circle’s blessing for druids ready to join the Druids of the Claw. At the Moonkin Stone west of Camp Taurajo, the dust calls Lunaclaw, a sacred beast bound to test each initiate. Defeating the guardian tests strength and resolve. The trial teaches the young druid the strength of body and heart needed to take the form of a bear.
